structure_display.line: Drawn with the chromium bonded to the ring nitrogen and one carboxylate oxygen of each of its three picolinates, three five-membered rings; PubChem's one-line structure leaves the chromium apart.

why_it_matters.text: The chromium form sold in supplements for blood sugar and appetite. Three picolinate rings cradle one chromium atom, and the FDA calls the evidence for its blood sugar claim highly uncertain.

description: The chromium form sold in supplements for blood sugar and appetite. Three picolinate rings cradle one chromium atom, and the FDA calls the evidence for its blood sugar claim highly uncertain.

parts.label: The ring system
parts.sentence: Rings joined where they share atoms, or a single ring standing alone. Atoms in a ring are held in place, so this part keeps its shape while chains around it can bend.
